record.question:
Fill in the blanks with the correct form of verbs given in brackets :
(a) He ____ here since 2009. (work)
(b) Have you ____ any thoughts on this matter? (give)
(c) Mother has never _____ of her childhood. (speak)
(d) This book ____ only 50 rupees last year. (cost)
(e) The man ____ a criminal. (be)
(f) He jumped off the bus while it ____ . (move)
(g) The sun ____ in the east. (rise) (10×1=10)
(h) I did not ____ anything last night. (hear)
(i) I ___ her while I was in Lunglei. (meet)
(j) You should not ____ that last week. (do)
